permitted.forwarded_header: X-Ugence-Approver-Proof on POST /review/decisions only, verbatim, never parsed, logged or persisted (ID-1)

configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_REVIEW_SERVICE_URL: optional; read by DeploymentConfig and handed to build_studio_context(review_service_base_url=...) and nowhere else
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH: optional; read by DeploymentConfig and handed to build_studio_context(activation_root=...) and nowhere else; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume (front-door seam 1, FD-5)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID: optional; the one tenant the Authority screen displays; required with UGENCE_STUDIO_POLICY_IDENTITIES; typed (NFC, no whitespace); read by DeploymentConfig only (front-door seam 2, FD-6)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_POLICY_IDENTITIES: optional; comma-separated typed policy identities '<policy_family>|<policy_id>|<scope>' (each NFC, no whitespace, no duplicates; no discovery, no default); requires UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH and UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID; handed to build_studio_context(policy_registry=..., policy_identities=...) and nowhere else (front-door seam 2, FD-6)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_SIMULATION_PROVIDER: optional; exactly '1' enables the one pinned in-image simulation provider handed to build_studio_context(provider_registry=...) and nowhere else; unset leaves the Simulate screen on its typed gap simulation_providers; any other value is refused before bind (front-door seam 3, FD-7)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_PATH: optional; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume; the tenant-bound system registry (ai-system-registry 0.2.0 SqliteSystemRegistry) handed to build_studio_context(system_registry=..., registered_by=<deployment name/version>) and nowhere else; requires UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID (front-door seam 5, FD-9)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_DATA_USE_DECLARATIONS_PATH: optional; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume; the tenant-bound data-use declarations file (data-use-admission 0.2.0 SqliteDataUseDeclarations) handed to build_studio_context(data_use_declarations=..., recorded_by=<deployment name/version>) and nowhere else; requires UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID (front-door seam 8, FD-12)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_VENDOR_DECLARATIONS_PATH: optional; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume; the tenant-bound vendor declarations file (vendor-dependency 0.2.0 SqliteVendorDeclarations) handed to build_studio_context(vendor_declarations=..., recorded_by=<deployment name/version>) and nowhere else; requires UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID (front-door seam 9, FD-13)

constitution_registry.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-5 SCREEN_1_ONLY (activation root)
constitution_registry.store: SqlitePolicyRegistry (policy-authority Posture B) at UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH, a file under the writable runtime volume /var/run/ugence-studio
constitution_registry.durability: that of the runtime volume's mount; the prohibited persistent_database (an external database server, driver or DSN) stands: no server, no driver, no DSN
constitution_registry.trust: the constitution authority's DenyAllSignatureVerifier and DenyAllApprovalVerifier and a signer that refuses every act; no key material, no trust anchor, no credential in the image or the container
constitution_registry.reachable_acts: preflight only (mutation-free) through the activation root; read-only, tenant-bound authority reads (issued records for configured identities, one record by id, its revocations and supersessions) through ReadOnlyTenantBoundRegistry over the same registry instance; issuance, revocation, supersession and activation have no route and refuse if invoked
constitution_registry.unset: the Constitution screen reports the typed gap constitution_preflight (available false)

governance_hook (seam 3, FD-7.3 RUNTIME_DEFAULT_BLOCK: the runtime's fail-closed default applies; FD-7.5: a permissive hook is prohibited and refused before bind)

front_door_seams.persistent_database: prohibition stands: the registry is the seam-1 sqlite file under the runtime volume, the seam-5 registrations, the seam-8 data-use declarations and the seam-9 vendor declarations three more files beside it; no server, no driver, no DSN

prohibited_definitions.agent_execution: agent execution against any non-fixture provider (FD-7.1 FIXTURE_RUN_ADMISSIBLE, ruled 2026-09-06): a run whose every provider is the in-image no-I/O simulation provider, under DRY_RUN, SIMULATION or SHADOW, is a demonstration and not agent execution; LIVE is absent from the mode list and refused by the studio; external_model_calls and external_tool_calls stand unchanged; asking the separate governed runtime worker to start the fixture workflow it already owns, over FIXTURE_ONLY providers, with nothing supplied by the studio, is display and transmit in FD-7.1's sense and not execution (FD-10.1 START_IS_A_RELAY, ruled 2026-09-06)

provider.behaviour: records each invocation in memory and returns success; opens no socket, reads no file, spawns nothing, holds no credential

simulation.registry: ProviderRegistry holding exactly that one provider, built in-process by build_simulation_registry(); no provider list is read from the environment (FD-4: no discovery, no default)
simulation.governance_hook: absent by ruling (FD-7.3): the runtime's own UnconfiguredGovernanceHook applies, so every consequential task BLOCKs with GOVERNANCE_NOT_CONFIGURED and the trace shows it; governance_hook_configured is false in every answer
simulation.permissive_hook: prohibited (FD-7.5): the composition root refuses any hook handed to the Simulate service before bind (refuse_permissive_hook) and startup integrity fails if this package's source could construct one (simulation_no_permissive_hook); governance_hook_permissive is false in every answer
simulation.live: absent from the mode list and refused by the studio with a typed 422
simulation.unset: the Simulate screen reports the typed gap simulation_providers (available false)
simulation.composition_record: composition-record.json (an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration, FD-3), superseding the seam-2 record kept byte-for-byte as composition-record.seam-2.json

worker_shadow_run.simulate_screen: two labelled paths, never merged (FD-10.5): the seam-3 in-process fixture run and this worker relay, each with its executor, hook and maturity; no path is chosen for the operator

worker_ledger_observe.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-11.1 OBSERVE_OVER_WORKER_LEDGER, FD-11.2 READ_PORT_IN_CONTROL_PLANE_ROOT, FD-11.3 SEVENTH_ROUTE_LEDGER_READ, FD-11.4 TWO_LABELLED_SOURCES, FD-11.5 READ_ONLY_ONE_STEP_AMENDMENT
worker_ledger_observe.route: GET /review/audit/{correlation_id} on the governed runtime worker (control-plane-root 0.2.0 read_entries, governed-review-service 0.6.0, governed-runtime-worker 0.3.0), reached through the same UGENCE_STUDIO_REVIEW_SERVICE_URL as the review screens; no configuration value, image package, credential or second egress destination is added
worker_ledger_observe.what_crosses: a typed correlation id in the path and nothing else; the worker reads its own tenant's rows; the answer is the worker's entries (seq, entry_ref, kind, recorded_at, recorded_by, correlation_id, payload, prev_digest, record_digest) and its own chain verification, returned unchanged
worker_ledger_observe.refusals: REFUSED_INTEGRITY (chain does not verify; entries withheld), REFUSED_SCHEMA, REFUSED_UNCONFIGURED as the worker said them; an unknown correlation id is a typed not-found, distinguished from unreachable; the studio re-derives, re-orders and re-hashes nothing
worker_ledger_observe.observe_screen: two labelled sources, never merged (FD-11.4): the worker audit ledger (receipts and references, raw, REFERENCE_GRADE, durable and hash-chained) and the console's typed gap console_api while FD-8.1 holds; each labelled with its record type, executor and maturity; no source is chosen for the operator
worker_ledger_observe.mutation_boundary: read-only: no append, edit or verification-trigger route exists from the studio; the ledger's only writer stays the review service's own linkage append on a GRANT (HE-1)
worker_ledger_observe.contract: v2_observe_ledger_chain, the third amendment of the frozen v2 contract (v2-A3), recorded in frozen.openapi_v2_amendment
worker_ledger_observe.unset: the worker-ledger source reports the typed gap review_service (available false); an older worker without the route is a typed not-found
worker_ledger_observe.composition_record: composition-record.json (an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration, FD-3), superseding the seam-6 record kept byte-for-byte as composition-record.seam-6.json

clearance_export.contract: v2_export_read, the sixth amendment of the frozen v2 contract (v2-A6), recorded in frozen.openapi_v2_amendment
clearance_export.reads_only: one GET and nothing else; no write, no operation that accepts a receipt, no new egress destination and no credential (CE-5, ADR §13.3)
clearance_export.source: seeded from clearance_receipts.json inside the scenario directories the pinned synthetic manifest already hashes; read at composition time and never written (CE-7). No store, no server, no driver, no DSN
clearance_export.confers: nothing: a seeded receipt exercises the export path and the verifier and is evidence about serialization and integrity and nothing else. No authority granted it and it satisfies no obligation (ADR §13.1)
clearance_export.authenticity_prerequisite: TrustAnchorResolverPort exists in trusted-evidence-authority and no signing key or trust root is configured; content-addressing establishes integrity, never authenticity
